source.raw_prompt: Add a fixture-level pre-check confirming a new staged agent's raw JSON transport (no Markdown code fence, no leading or trailing prose) is validated before any semantic or schema parsing is attempted.

objective: Confirm and document that a new staged agent's raw JSON transport format is validated (fence/prose rejected) before any semantic or schema parsing is attempted, applying the memory-loop's prior transport lesson to this task's own acceptance criteria.
constraints: Apply lesson L-20260806-TRANSPORT-BUDGET (source run run-20260803-riskband-001, memory/lessons-learned.md): a new staged agent's raw JSON transport format (no Markdown code fence, no leading/trailing prose) must be validated and, if malformed, classified as a transport failure and handled via the one-per-phase correction budget BEFORE any semantic or schema validation of its content is attempted -- never validate content first and treat transport as an afterthought.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a raw agent reply, the transport-format check (strict JSON parse, no fence, no prose) runs and can block before any semantic/schema validator is ever invoked on that reply, matching lesson L-20260806-TRANSPORT-BUDGET's ordering requirement.

task_graph.description: Confirm transport-before-semantic validation ordering is real in the current codebase (harness/orchestrator/core.py's _parse_raw/_drive_staged_protocol) and cite it as the evidence for AC-1 -- a Research-only task; no code change is in scope for this narrow demonstration.
